subject: Request: Trial extension & institutional credits for ClimateX Lab

Subject: Request: institutional credits for ClimateX Lab - summer extension

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — I’m Lila Sen, PI of the ClimateX Lab at ClimateX University. We piloted Redwood for a class project last spring and had great results. A new research cohort (15 students + 3 postdocs) starts next month and our grant timeline shifted, so we’re short on paid credits.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a 6-month trial extension or an academic credit grant (~100k tokens/month) for our lab to finish data collection and the resulting evaluations? We’re prepared to provide the student roster, a short statement of research purpose, and a copy of our institutional award letter.

Attached: ClimateX_ResearchProposal.pdf, StudentRoster_aug2026.csv

We’re on a tight timeline — would appreciate any fast-path approvals or a short-term promo code while paperwork is reviewed. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Lila Sen
Professor of Environmental Data Science
ClimateX University

Monica / Rafael — forwarding an EDU credit request. ClimateX is a recurring academic partner; PI is asking for a 6-month extension ~100k tokens/month for a research cohort. They included proposal and roster.

Questions:
- Is there an existing EDU promo we can apply, or do we need a one-off approval?
- Any required paperwork (MOU, AA)? They can produce award letter and SOC2-redacted.pdf if needed.

If we can approve a promo code for immediate relief while legal/finance reviews, that will keep the research timeline on track. Rafael, can you propose a promo structure and estimated revenue impact? Monica, would you approve a discretionary credit grant for academic research up to 600k tokens across 6 months (to be tracked under PLG-EDU-2026-0089)?

Thanks — I can coordinate onboarding and token provisioning once we have sign-off.

— Neha

Thanks for the context, Neha. Quick proposal:
- Approve a 6-month promotional credit: total 600k tokens (100k/month).
- Apply as a non-revenue promotional grant tied to deal PLG-EDU-2026-0089 for tracking (HubSpot link attached).
- Require: the student roster and a signed research use agreement (RUA) confirming non-commercial research use.

Estimated cost impact: low (academic usage, expected token mix X->Y), and high upside for reference case + published evaluation.

Suggested immediate step: issue a temporary promo code (edu-climatex-2026-temp) good for 30 days to unblock access while legal/finance review the RUA and SOC2 evidence. Finance will log the promo as an expense-backed credit.

If Monica is OK with the discretionary credit, I’ll open the HubSpot deal, generate the promo code, and add the tracking fields.

Rafael Mendes

I’m authorizing a one-off academic credits grant: 600k tokens (100k/month for 6 months) under deal PLG-EDU-2026-0089. Rafael — please:
